_about: Providers that were researched for the Resources directory but not added, so nobody researches them again without a reason. Shown in docs/RESOURCES-REGISTRY.md. Add an entry whenever a candidate is dropped; remove it once the provider is added.

leftOut.name: Literacy Council of Montgomery County
leftOut.reason: Its old web address (literacycouncilmcmd.org) now shows unrelated spam content; no current official page found.

leftOut.name: Fairfax County Coordinated Services Planning (CSP)
leftOut.reason: Official county page could not be loaded to confirm phone and hours.

leftOut.name: Virginia Career Works: Prince William Center
leftOut.reason: Address and phone found only on third-party sites, not on an official page.

leftOut.name: Greater Baden Medical Services (Prince George's County centers)
leftOut.reason: Its website lists only Southern Maryland (Charles and St. Mary's) centers, so no Prince George's site could be confirmed.

leftOut.name: Latino Economic Development Center (LEDC)
leftOut.reason: Website did not load to confirm offices and phone.

leftOut.name: Byte Back
leftOut.reason: Its website could not be read and no current program details, dates or eligibility were found on an official page; older pages describe free CompTIA A+ and digital literacy classes.

leftOut.name: Generation USA (Generation JobSprint)
leftOut.reason: Not a tech bootcamp: its only open program is JobSprint, a free 3-week online job-search course with no start dates published. Its former free IT Support Specialist program is no longer listed. Could fit Employment once dates are published.

leftOut.name: ChooseU (formerly Generation USA)
leftOut.area: Guilford County, NC; Dallas-Fort Worth, TX
leftOut.reason: Independent of Generation since 2024; runs manufacturing technician pathways, not tech training, and nothing in DC, Maryland or Virginia.

leftOut.name: mthree (Wiley Edge) Graduate Programme
leftOut.reason: Hire-train-deploy program, but its U.S. careers page doesn't state training length, pay, commitment, relocation or eligibility.

leftOut.name: SkillStorm
leftOut.reason: Hire-train-deploy program for emerging engineers, but its careers page doesn't state whether training is paid, its length, the commitment or locations.

leftOut.name: Genesis10 Dev10
leftOut.reason: Hire-train-deploy program (reported two-year client commitments), but its website could not be read to confirm terms.

leftOut.name: Montgomery College TechMAP
leftOut.reason: Its page says it is no longer accepting applicants; Montgomery College's Cyber Workforce Accelerator is listed instead.

leftOut.name: Apprenticeship DC (DC Department of Employment Services)
leftOut.reason: A directory of registered apprenticeship sponsors, not a training program with its own application; individual sponsors would need checking one by one.

leftOut.name: Maryland Workforce Association: Cybersecurity Support Technician Registered Apprenticeship
leftOut.reason: Found only in news coverage; no official page with how to apply.
